title: Beginner English Speaking Practice | Real-Life Role Play (A1)

header.titleZh: 初級英語口說練習 |現實生活角色扮演 (A1)
header.titleEn: Beginner English Speaking Practice | Real-Life Role Play (A1)

sentences.en: Let's shadow some simple English sentences. To shadow is to repeat.
sentences.tc: 讓我們來看看一些簡單的英語句子。影子就是重複。

sentences.en: I'm blue and you're red.
sentences.tc: 我是藍色，你是紅色。

sentences.en: I'm a little tired. I didn't sleep much last night. The upstairs neighbor had loud music playing all night long. Yes,.
sentences.tc: 我有點累了。我昨晚沒睡多少覺。樓上的鄰居整晚都在大聲播放音樂。是的，。

sentences.en: He had company. I know. Who has a party on a Tuesday night? Seriously, the music was so loud.
sentences.tc: 他有同伴。我知道。誰在星期二晚上舉辦聚會？說實話，音樂實在太吵了。

tags.note: 看到 loud 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 night 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: It was so disrespectful. No, I was too tired to do anything about it.
sentences.tc: 這太不尊重了。不，我太累了，無能為力。

sentences.en: I put a pillow over my head and I tried to fall asleep.
sentences.tc: 我把枕頭放在頭上，試著入睡。

sentences.en: I know. I really need my sleep.
sentences.tc: 我知道。我真的需要睡覺。

sentences.en: I don't. Yeah,.
sentences.tc: 我不知道。是的，。

tags.note: 看到 real 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I think I will.
sentences.tc: 我想我會的。

sentences.en: I have to hopefully tonight will be quiet. Anyways, how was your weekend? No way.
sentences.tc: 我希望今晚會很安靜。無論如何，你周末過得怎麼樣？決不。

sentences.en: You have loud neighbors, too. >> Nice. Where did you go? You always ask me.
sentences.tc: 你也有吵鬧的鄰居。 >> 不錯。你去哪裡？你總是問我。

sentences.en: What the most important part of learning English is. For me, language is meant for communication. So practicing real life situations is much more important than just learning from textbooks. Let me?
sentences.tc: 學習英語最重要的部分是什麼。對我來說，語言是為了溝通。因此，練習現實生活中的情況比僅僅從課本上學習重要得多。讓我來？

tags.note: 看到 important 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 loud 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 night 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: Tell you the story about what happened to me at the airport in Brazil.
sentences.tc: 告訴你我在巴西機場發生的故事。

sentences.en: I had studied some Portuguese before and I felt confident that I could speak in Brazil.
sentences.tc: 我以前學過一些葡萄牙語，我對自己能在巴西講話充滿信心。

sentences.en: I felt confident with the vocabulary that I knew. So, when I arrived at the airport.
sentences.tc: 我對自己所掌握的詞彙充滿信心。所以，當我到達機場時。

sentences.en: I realized my phone didn't have any battery, I couldn't order an Uber to my hostel,.
sentences.tc: 我意識到我的手機沒有電池了，我無法叫 Uber 去我的旅館。

tags.note: 看到 felt 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 real 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 airport 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: It was okay.
sentences.tc: 沒關係。

sentences.en: I would just order a taxi. So, I went up to a taxi driver.
sentences.tc: 我只想叫一輛計程車。於是，我去找計程車司機。

sentences.en: I froze. I knew each word individually, but forming a full sentence,.
sentences.tc: 我愣住了。我單獨認識每個單詞，但形成一個完整的句子。

sentences.en: I felt like a failure. All those hours of studying to waste.
sentences.tc: 我覺得自己很失敗。所有那些學習時間都浪費了。

tags.note: 看到 felt 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 taxi 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I couldn't even ask for a taxi. I realized.
sentences.tc: 我甚至不能叫出租車。我意識到了。

sentences.en: Then just how important.
sentences.tc: 那就多麼重要。

sentences.en: It is to learn a language for real conversations, not just textbook learning.
sentences.tc: 學習語言是為了真正的對話，而不僅僅是教科書上的學習。

sentences.en: If you're learning English and often feel stuck in real life conversations, I completely understand.
sentences.tc: 如果你正在學習英語並且經常感到陷入現實生活對話中，我完全理解。
